run_densepose_evaluation: run densepose COCO evaluation by creating a denseposeCOCOeval object with ground truth and detection results then calling evaluate accumulate and summarize
compute_ogps_iou: compute the OGPS IoU between densepose detections and ground truth using computeOgps with image and category ids
find_closest_smpl_vertices: find closest SMPL mesh vertices for predicted and ground truth UV points using findAllClosestVerts
compute_geodesic_distances: compute pairwise geodesic distances between ground truth and predicted mesh vertices using getDistances
configure_uv_evaluation_params: configure UV evaluation parameters by creating a Params object with iouType uv to set IoU thresholds recall thresholds and max detections
